final: WITH line_totals AS (SELECT b.budget_id, COALESCE(SUM(x.cost), 0) AS total_cost, COUNT(x.expense_id) AS expense_count FROM budget AS b LEFT JOIN expense AS x ON x.link_to_budget = b.budget_id GROUP BY b.budget_id), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(total_cost) AS avg_total FROM line_totals) SELECT AVG(l.total_cost) AS average_total, SUM(l.expense_count) AS total_expenses, AVG(l.total_cost - a.avg_total) AS average_excess FROM line_totals AS l CROSS JOIN overall_avg AS a WHERE l.total_cost > a.avg_total
